movement_profile: Roshan curious toy racer; hands keep wheel/handlebar contact, seated tail, small purposeful look into turn; simulation owns translation/jump, authored pose owns steering/acceleration acting

clip_contract.entry: straight seated at measured tire contact anchor
clip_contract.turn: threshold steer +/-0.25, key held while sustained, minimum .16s between key changes
clip_contract.boost: straight forward-lean key while accelerating; turn retains priority
clip_contract.exit: straight resting pose at the same wheel contact anchor
clip_contract.events: No pose frame awards progress or emits economy events; KartGame alone owns rewards
clip_contract.interruptions: pause/focus/back clear held input; simulation pauses without reward, release settles to straight
clip_contract.shadow: ground contact owned separately from actor lift
clip_contract.study: Four comparable authored chase keys per ride, inspected at native size and later in-context captures; no interpolated acting
clip_contract.gaps: Head turns are broad; smooth intermediate steering poses and owner anatomy review remain pending
